C1683.title: Preinstall to persistence: Inside the Red Hat npm Miasma credential stealing campaign
C1683.summary: Microsoft disclosed a large-scale npm supply chain attack in which threat actors compromised packages associated with @redhat-cloud-services and injected malicious code across more than 90 versions.
